Mansoor Ansari @ Mansur Ansari @ Jitendra, aged about 38 years, S/o-Hamid Ansari,
R/o-Khutiyapada, P.S. & P.O.- Jagannathpur, District-West Singhbhum, Jharkhand ... ...
CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : M/s. Rupesh Singh, Advocate For the State : M/s. Rakesh Ranjan, A.P.P.
-----
02/07.11.2025 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Jagannathpur P.S. Case No. 87 of 2020 arising out of POCSO Case No. 47 of 2021, for the offences registered under Sections 376(2)(i),
376(2)(n), 376(2)(f) of the I.P.C. and Sections 4 & 6 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions, Judge-II-cum-Special Judge, POCSO Act Cases, West Singhbhum,
Chaibasa.
3. The petitioner is alleged to have raped his daughter.
4. It was submitted that the victim and the informant who is the mother of the victim have been examined during the trial.
Mansoor Ansari @ Mansur Ansari @ ... vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ... Opposite ... on 7 November, 2025

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that both the victim and the informant have supported the prosecution case.
6. In view of the aforesaid facts, I am not inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.
Accordingly, his prayer for bail stands rejected.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) November 07, 2025 Nandini/-
